title: First-time buyer under contract and ready to go
scenario: Sofia just had an offer accepted on her first home and calls ready to move fast. Multiple buying signals about documents, timeline and appraisal; the rep stays compliant on rate questions.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi, is this Megan? Sofia, I talked to you last month. Our offer got accepted!

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sofia! Congratulations! That's huge.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thank you! I'm freaking out a little. So what do I do now? What are the next steps?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, deep breath, this is the fun part. First, can you send me the signed purchase contract?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes, my agent just emailed it to me. I'll forward it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. Then I'll need your last two pay stubs, two months of bank statements and last year's W-2.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, I have all of that. Do you need it today?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: The sooner the better, since your contract has deadlines. What's your closing date on the contract?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: December twelfth. Is that enough time? How fast can you close?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a reasonable window. The main thing that drives timing is the appraisal and how fast documents come in, so if you get me everything this week we'll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, I'll do it tonight. Oh, and do I lock my rate now? What's the rate going to be?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Good question. I can't give you a number until we have the contract and your file reviewed, but once we do, we'll talk through locking options and I'll show you exactly what's available that day.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, that makes sense.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Also, have you picked a homeowners insurance company yet?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: No! Do I need that already?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: You'll need it before closing, so it's worth getting a couple quotes this week.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, adding it to my list. My list is getting long.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, it'll get shorter fast. Is the house the blue one with the porch you sent me?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes! With the lemon tree in the back.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Love it. Okay, I'll send you the upload link right now. Can we do a quick check-in Thursday or Friday to make sure everything came through?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Friday. Thank you so much, Megan.
